historical_logic_findings_reconfirmed: TachyonPredictor is an empirical local-neighborhood/recent-mean score estimator, not future-information access.
SimpleBayesianOptimizer is not a Bayesian surrogate/acquisition implementation.
relay_step reads get_best but does not call bayes.tell, so optimizer learning is not actually closed in the shown relay path.
cobble_generator mutates a clone and then reinitializes it through __init__, erasing the mutation/model state before use.
piston_push removes the weakest active agent, which conflicts with the modern NO_LEARNING_ENTITY_DELETION law.
UI language converts the Tachyon estimate into percent improvement although the predictor returns empirical mean score.
